tagline.en: AI avatar and talking head videos from a portrait
tagline.zh: 由肖像图生成 AI 数字人与口播视频

summary.en: This skill creates talking head and avatar videos from a portrait image. It runs apps through the inference.sh belt CLI. The recommended app, P-Video-Avatar, creates speech from a text script with built-in TTS, so you do not need a separate audio step.
summary.zh: 这个技能用一张肖像图生成口播视频和数字人视频，通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行应用。推荐使用的 P-Video-Avatar 内置语音合成，可以直接根据文字脚本生成语音，不需要单独的音频步骤。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 调用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image models from the command line through the belt CLI and inference.sh. It covers text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, LoRA styles, upscaling and text rendering. It gives you one way to call many image models, such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 belt CLI 和 inference.sh 在命令行中调用 AI 图片模型。它支持文生图、图片编辑、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、放大和文字渲染。你可以用同一种方式调用 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等多个模型。

tagline.en: Generate AI videos from text, images, and references
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 生成 AI 视频

summary.en: This skill runs AI video models through the belt CLI from inference.sh. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, avatars and lipsync, video editing, upscaling, and sound effects. You pick a model by its app ID and pass a JSON input.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 AI 视频模型。支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、数字人与口型同步、视频编辑、超分和音效生成。你用应用 ID 选择模型，再传入 JSON 输入。

tagline.en: Distinct visual design for new or existing UI
tagline.zh: 为新建或现有界面做有辨识度的视觉设计

summary.en: Guidance for designing UI with a distinct visual identity instead of template defaults. It covers aesthetic direction, typography, layout, and copy, and asks the agent to plan and review before writing code. The aim is a design that fits the brief's subject and does not look like a generated page.
summary.zh: 这是一套界面视觉设计指南，目标是让界面有自己的风格，而不是套用模板。内容包括审美方向、字体、版面和文案。代理在写代码前会先做方案并自我审查。结果应贴合需求的主题，而不像生成的通用页面。

tagline.en: Create, test and improve agent skills
tagline.zh: 创建、测试并改进智能体技能

summary.en: Skill Creator helps you build a new agent skill or improve an existing one. It covers the whole cycle: defining the skill, writing a draft SKILL.md, running test prompts, reviewing results, and revising. It also includes a method for tuning the skill description so the skill triggers for the right requests.
summary.zh: Skill Creator 帮你新建一个智能体技能，或改进已有的技能。它覆盖完整流程：明确技能要做什么，写出 SKILL.md 草稿，运行测试提示词，查看结果，再进行修改。它还提供调整技能描述的方法，让技能在正确的请求下被触发。

tagline.en: Persistent Chromium profiles with fixed device fingerprints
tagline.zh: 每个配置文件固定一套真实设备指纹的 Chromium

summary.en: anti-detect-browser lets you drive Chromium through standard Playwright APIs in JavaScript or Python. Each profile keeps one device fingerprint, cookies and storage across runs, and can use its own proxy. It is for keeping separate accounts apart and for testing sites under controlled device and region settings.
summary.zh: anti-detect-browser 让你用标准 Playwright 接口驱动 Chromium，支持 JavaScript 和 Python。每个配置文件在多次运行之间保留同一套设备指纹、Cookie 和存储，并可绑定自己的代理。适合管理彼此隔离的账号，以及在可控的设备和地区条件下测试网站。

tagline.en: Ranked conversion fix list for landing and checkout pages
tagline.zh: 落地页转化审计，输出按收益排序的修复清单

summary.en: This skill audits a landing page, sales page, opt-in page, product page or checkout flow for conversion leaks. It returns a fix list ordered by expected revenue impact, where each finding names the element, the failure mode and the change to make. It is meant for pages that get paid traffic but do not convert well.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于审计落地页、销售页、留资页、产品页和结账流程中的转化漏点。它会输出一份按预期收益影响排序的修复清单，每条发现都写明具体元素、问题类型和应做的修改。它适用于已经有付费流量、但转化效果不好的页面。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via one CLI
tagline.zh: 通过一个 CLI 调用 50 多个 AI 模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image generation, editing, inpainting, and upscaling through the inference.sh `belt` CLI. It covers models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve from one command interface. It is meant for art, mockups, social graphics, and marketing visuals.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 `belt` CLI 完成 AI 图片生成、编辑、局部重绘和放大。它在同一套命令下支持 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等模型。适用于艺术创作、产品效果图、社交媒体图和营销视觉。

tagline.en: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 代理的浏览器自动化工具

summary.en: Browser automation for AI agents, run through the inference.sh belt CLI. It opens pages, lists interactive elements as @e refs, and lets an agent click, fill, drag, upload, and run JavaScript. It can also take screenshots and record video of a session.
summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 代理的浏览器自动化技能，通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行。它可以打开页面，把可交互元素列为 @e 引用，并让代理执行点击、填写、拖放、上传文件和运行 JavaScript 等操作。它还能截图，并录制会话视频。

tagline.en: Run hosted AI apps from a CLI, no GPU needed
tagline.zh: 在命令行运行云端AI应用，无需GPU

summary.en: agent-tools is a skill that gives an agent access to inference.sh through the belt CLI. It can run hosted AI apps for images, video, LLMs, web search, 3D generation, and Twitter/X actions. You pass each app a JSON input and get the result back, without setting up your own models or GPUs.
summary.zh: agent-tools 是一个技能，让智能体通过 belt CLI 使用 inference.sh。它可以运行云端托管的 AI 应用，用于生成图片和视频、调用大语言模型、网页搜索、生成 3D 模型，以及执行 Twitter/X 操作。每个应用接收一段 JSON 输入并返回结果，无需自己部署模型或配置 GPU。

tagline.en: Generate AI videos from text, images and references
tagline.zh: 用文字、图片和参考图生成 AI 视频

summary.en: This skill runs AI video models from the command line through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, lipsync, avatars, video editing, upscaling and sound effects, with 40+ models such as Veo, Seedance, Kling, Wan and HappyHorse.
summary.zh: 这个 skill 通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具调用 AI 视频模型。它支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、口型同步、数字人、视频编辑、超分和音效，覆盖 Veo、Seedance、Kling、Wan、HappyHorse 等 40 多个模型。

tagline.en: Store screenshot specs, gallery order and preview videos
tagline.zh: 商店截图规范、图库顺序与预览视频

summary.en: This skill helps you make App Store and Google Play screenshots and preview videos. It lists the exact iOS and Android sizes, the order of the gallery, caption rules, and how to generate images and video with the belt CLI from inference.sh. It is for developers who want listing images that meet store specs and show the app's value in the first three screenshots.
summary.zh: 这个技能帮你制作 App Store 和 Google Play 的截图与预览视频。它列出 iOS 和 Android 的准确尺寸、图库排列顺序、文案规则，并说明如何通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具生成图片和视频。适合希望商店素材符合规范，并在前三张截图中展示应用价值的开发者。

tagline.en: Consistent AI-generated characters with reference sheets
tagline.zh: 用参考设定表保持AI角色形象一致

summary.en: A skill for keeping one character looking the same across many AI-generated images. It covers turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, a reusable description anchor, and LoRA training. It runs through the inference.sh CLI (belt).
summary.zh: 这个技能用于让同一角色在多张AI生成图片中保持一致。内容包括多角度设定图、表情表、配色表、可复用的外貌描述，以及LoRA训练方法。它通过inference.sh的命令行工具belt运行。

tagline.en: Structured competitor analysis: research, matrices, SWOT, UX
tagline.zh: 结构化竞品分析：调研、对比矩阵与SWOT

summary.en: Competitor Teardown gives a structure for analyzing competitors across product, pricing, positioning, traction, reviews, content, and team. It runs research queries and page screenshots through the inference.sh belt CLI. It also provides templates for feature matrices, pricing tables, SWOT, positioning maps, and summary reports.
summary.zh: Competitor Teardown 提供一套竞品分析结构，覆盖产品、定价、定位、增长、用户评价、内容和团队七个层面。它通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 执行调研查询和页面截图。同时提供功能矩阵、价格对比、SWOT、定位图和汇总报告的模板。

tagline.en: Turn still images into short animated video clips
tagline.zh: 把静态图片变成带动态的短视频

summary.en: A guide for turning still images into short videos with the belt CLI. It covers which image-to-video model to use, how to write motion prompts, and how to specify camera movement. It includes models such as Wan 2.7 i2v, Seedance 2.5, and Kling v4.
summary.zh: 这是一份使用 belt CLI 把静态图片转为短视频的指南。内容包括如何选择图生视频模型、如何写运动提示词，以及如何设置镜头运动。涵盖 Wan 2.7 i2v、Seedance 2.5、Kling v4 等模型。

tagline.en: Run cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs and search
tagline.zh: 命令行运行云端AI应用，覆盖图像、视频、大模型与搜索

summary.en: infsh-cli is a command-line tool for running hosted AI apps on inference.sh. It covers image and video generation, LLM calls, web search, 3D generation and Twitter/X actions, all through the `belt` command. The apps run in the cloud, so no local GPU is needed.
summary.zh: infsh-cli 是一个命令行工具，用于运行 inference.sh 上托管的 AI 应用。它通过 `belt` 命令提供图像和视频生成、大模型调用、网页搜索、3D 生成以及 Twitter/X 操作。应用在云端运行，不需要本地 GPU。

tagline.en: Layout and copy rules for landing pages that convert
tagline.zh: 落地页转化设计的布局与文案规则

summary.en: This skill gives rules for designing landing pages that convert. It covers the above-the-fold layout, headlines, hero images, CTA buttons, section order, forms, and mobile design. It also includes belt CLI commands to generate hero and OG images and to run web research.
summary.zh: 这个技能提供落地页转化设计的规则，涵盖首屏布局、标题、主图、CTA 按钮、板块顺序、表单和移动端设计。它还提供 belt CLI 命令，用于生成首图和分享图，以及进行网页调研。

tagline.en: Plan and prepare a Product Hunt launch
tagline.zh: 规划并准备 Product Hunt 产品发布

summary.en: This skill helps you plan a Product Hunt launch. It covers listing specs, gallery images, taglines, launch timing, maker comments, and launch day steps. It also uses the belt CLI to generate gallery images and search for competitor launches.
summary.zh: 本技能帮助你规划 Product Hunt 产品发布。内容包括列表规格、画廊图片、标语、发布时间、Maker 评论和发布当天的流程。它还能通过 belt CLI 生成画廊图片，并搜索竞品的发布情况。

tagline.en: AI product photography for e-commerce and lifestyle shots
tagline.zh: 用AI生成电商产品图与生活场景图

summary.en: This skill generates product images with AI through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers hero shots, white-background packshots, lifestyle, scale, detail and group shots, with rules for angles, lighting, shadows and backgrounds. It also includes marketplace requirements such as Amazon's white background and frame fill.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具，用AI生成产品图。它覆盖主图、纯白背景棚拍图、生活场景图、尺寸参照图、细节图和组合图，并给出角度、布光、阴影和背景的规则。它还包含亚马逊等平台的要求，例如纯白背景和主体占画面比例。

tagline.en: Run Python code in a sandbox with 100+ libraries
tagline.zh: 在沙箱中运行 Python 代码

summary.en: python-executor runs Python code through the belt CLI in an isolated environment. It includes over 100 libraries, such as pandas, requests, Playwright, Pillow, OpenCV and trimesh. Files saved to outputs/ are returned with the result.
summary.zh: python-executor 通过 belt 命令行工具，在隔离环境中运行 Python 代码。环境内置 100 多个库，包括 pandas、requests、Playwright、Pillow、OpenCV 和 trimesh。保存到 outputs/ 目录的文件会随结果一起返回。

tagline.en: Render MP4 videos from React Remotion component code
tagline.zh: 用 Remotion 组件代码渲染 MP4 视频

summary.en: This skill takes React Remotion component code in TSX and renders it to an MP4 video through the inference.sh CLI (`belt`). You set the duration, frame rate, resolution, and optionally props and codec. It helps when you want to make a video from code instead of editing it by hand.
summary.zh: 这个技能接收 TSX 格式的 React Remotion 组件代码，通过 inference.sh CLI（belt）将其渲染为 MP4 视频。你可以设置时长、帧率、分辨率，还可以按需设置 props 和编码格式。当你想用代码生成视频，而不是手动编辑时，它很有用。

tagline.en: Plan film and video shots as AI-generated storyboard panels
tagline.zh: 用AI生成分镜面板，规划影视镜头

summary.en: This skill guides you through storyboarding for film, video, ads, music videos and animation. It gives you shot types, camera angles, camera movement, continuity rules and a panel annotation format. It also shows how to generate each panel with the inference.sh `belt` CLI and stitch the panels into a board.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于影视、视频、广告、音乐视频和动画的分镜制作。它提供景别、机位角度、运镜、连续性规则和分镜标注格式。它还说明如何用 inference.sh 的 `belt` 命令行工具生成每个分镜画面，并把画面拼成分镜板。

tagline.en: Platform specs and workflow for short video ads
tagline.zh: 按平台规格制作短视频广告的流程

summary.en: video-ad-specs gives exact specs for video ads on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn, including dimensions, duration limits and caption rules. It also gives an AIDA timing plan and commands for generating, voicing, merging and captioning ads with the inference.sh belt CLI.
summary.zh: video-ad-specs 提供 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook 和 LinkedIn 视频广告的具体规格，包括尺寸、时长上限和字幕要求。它还给出 AIDA 时间安排，以及使用 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 生成、配音、合并和加字幕的命令。

tagline.en: Web search and content extraction via the belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 进行网页搜索与内容提取

summary.en: This skill runs web search and URL content extraction through the inference.sh belt CLI. It offers five apps from Tavily and Exa, including AI-generated answers, direct factual answers, and clean text from URLs. It gives a developer a single command-line path to web sources for research and agent workflows.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 执行网页搜索和 URL 内容提取。它提供来自 Tavily 和 Exa 的五个应用，包括 AI 生成的答案、直接的事实性回答以及网页的干净正文。开发者可以在命令行中用同一种方式获取网页来源，用于研究和智能体工作流。

tagline.en: Design and check YouTube thumbnails with AI image generation
tagline.zh: 用 AI 生成并检查 YouTube 缩略图

summary.en: This skill guides YouTube thumbnail design. It gives the required sizes, safe zones, color and text rules, and face expression guidance. It also uses the belt CLI from inference.sh to generate thumbnail images from prompts.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于设计 YouTube 缩略图。它提供尺寸要求、安全区、配色和文字规则，以及人脸表情建议。它还通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI，根据提示词生成缩略图图片。

tagline.en: Drive a real browser over CDP for interactive web tasks
tagline.zh: 通过 CDP 直接操作真实浏览器，完成需要交互的网页任务

summary.en: browser-use gives an agent direct control of a Chrome or Chromium browser through the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). It covers clicks, typing, navigation, logged-in sessions, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, and bot-protected sites. It also covers hosted cloud browsers and the browser-use Python library.
summary.zh: browser-use 让智能体通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol（CDP）直接控制 Chrome 或 Chromium 浏览器。它能处理点击、输入、导航、已登录的会话、需要 JavaScript 渲染的页面、截图，以及有反爬限制的网站。它也支持托管的云端浏览器和 browser-use Python 库。

tagline.en: Raw ad, app, ranking and market data from AdMapix
tagline.zh: AdMapix 原始广告、应用、排行与市场数据

summary.en: This skill is a thin client for the AdMapix read API. It fetches ad creatives, app and developer data, rankings, download and revenue estimates, and market data, and returns them as raw JSON. The calling agent decides which endpoints to call and does any analysis.
summary.zh: 这个技能是 AdMapix 读取接口的轻量客户端。它获取广告素材、应用和开发者数据、排行榜、下载量与收入估算以及市场数据，并以原始 JSON 返回。调用方的智能体决定请求哪些接口，并自行完成分析。

tagline.en: Browser automation for AI agents using element refs
tagline.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的无头浏览器自动化

summary.en: This skill lets an AI agent drive a headless browser through the agent-browser CLI. It takes accessibility tree snapshots and selects elements by ref, such as @e2, so each action targets a known element. This makes multi-step browser workflows more predictable.
summary.zh: 这个技能让 AI 智能体通过 agent-browser 命令行工具操作无头浏览器。它读取无障碍树快照，并通过 @e2 这类元素引用来选择页面元素，使每一步操作都指向确定的元素。这样，多步骤的浏览器流程更容易稳定复现。

tagline.en: Persistent memory for agents: facts, lessons, entities
tagline.zh: 为智能体提供持久记忆：事实、经验与实体

summary.en: AgentMemory gives an AI agent a memory that lasts across sessions. It stores facts, records lessons from actions with their outcomes, and tracks people and projects as entities. The agent can search this memory when a new session starts.
summary.zh: AgentMemory 让 AI 智能体的记忆跨会话保留。它可以保存事实，记录每次行动的结果和经验，并把人物和项目作为实体进行跟踪。新会话开始时，智能体可以检索这些记忆。

tagline.en: Insurance needs, comparison and plans for mainland China
tagline.zh: 中国大陆保险需求分析、产品对比与方案设计

summary.en: AI Insurance Advisor helps with insurance questions for people in mainland China. It covers needs analysis, product comparison, premium calculation, plan design, insurance knowledge and compliance notes. It runs three local Python scripts and reads three static reference files, and it makes no network requests.
summary.zh: AI保险顾问为中国大陆的保险咨询提供支持，覆盖需求分析、产品对比、保费计算、方案设计、保险知识问答和合规提示。它调用三个本地Python脚本，读取三个只读参考文件，不发起任何网络请求。

tagline.en: Read and write Airtable records through Maton OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 授权读写 Airtable 记录

summary.en: This skill gives an agent access to the Airtable API through Maton, which handles OAuth. It covers bases, tables and records, including reads, creates, updates, deletes and queries with filter formulas. Calls run through the maton CLI, and the agent starts with read and list calls.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 Maton 让智能体访问 Airtable API，OAuth 授权由 Maton 处理。它覆盖多维表格（base）、数据表和记录，包括读取、创建、更新、删除，以及用筛选公式查询。调用通过 maton 命令行工具完成，智能体默认只做读取和列表调用。

tagline.en: Call apps the user connected via Maton's credential gateway
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 网关调用用户已连接的应用

summary.en: The api-gateway skill sends API calls to third-party apps through the Maton gateway. The gateway adds the stored credential for an app the user has already connected, so the agent does not handle app keys or OAuth itself. The skill also manages those connections and, for some apps, hosted functions, triggers and a local bridge, and each of these needs explicit user approval.
summary.zh: api-gateway 技能通过 Maton 网关向第三方应用发送 API 调用。网关会为用户已连接的应用附加已保存的凭证，因此代理无需自行处理应用密钥或 OAuth 授权。该技能还能管理这些连接，并在部分应用中管理托管函数、触发器和本地桥接服务。上述每项操作都需要用户明确批准。

tagline.en: Daily cron job to update Clawdbot and its skills
tagline.zh: 每天通过定时任务更新 Clawdbot 和技能

summary.en: Auto-Updater sets up a daily cron job that updates Clawdbot and all skills, then messages you a summary of what changed. It removes the need to run update commands by hand for Clawdbot and each skill.
summary.zh: Auto-Updater 会设置一个每日定时任务，更新 Clawdbot 和所有技能，然后给你发送一条变更摘要。你不再需要手动为 Clawdbot 和每个技能执行更新命令。

tagline.en: Web search through the Baidu AI Search API
tagline.zh: 通过百度AI搜索接口进行网页搜索

summary.en: baidu-search lets an OpenClaw agent run web searches through the Baidu AI Search Engine (BDSE). It is meant for live information, documentation lookups and research topics. It needs a BAIDU_API_KEY and python3.
summary.zh: baidu-search 让 OpenClaw 智能体通过百度AI搜索引擎（BDSE）执行网页搜索，适用于获取实时信息、查阅文档和研究类问题。使用前需要配置 BAIDU_API_KEY，并安装 python3。

tagline.en: Web search and page extraction via Brave Search API
tagline.zh: 通过 Brave Search API 进行网页搜索和页面内容提取

summary.en: brave-search runs web searches through the Brave Search API and can pull the readable text of result pages as markdown. It runs from the command line with no browser. It is meant for looking up documentation, facts, and other web content from a script or agent.
summary.zh: brave-search 通过 Brave Search API 执行网页搜索，并可将结果页面的可读正文提取为 Markdown。它从命令行运行，不需要浏览器。适合脚本或智能体查找文档、事实及其他网页内容。

tagline.en: Sub-agent for research, media, documents and code
tagline.zh: 面向研究、多媒体、文档与代码的子代理

summary.en: CellCog is a sub-agent that takes one request and returns several kinds of output. It reads files of many types and can produce research, images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, dashboards, 3D models, diagrams and code. Your agent hands off the task and gets the finished files back.
summary.zh: CellCog 是一个子代理，接收一次请求后可以返回多种类型的产出。它能读取多种格式的文件，生成研究报告、图片、视频、音频、文档、电子表格、仪表盘、3D 模型、图表和代码。你的代理把任务交出去，再取回完成的文件。

tagline.en: Drafts, edits and reviews Chinese official and news documents
tagline.zh: 起草、修改、审核中文公文与新闻稿件

summary.en: This skill helps write, rewrite, shorten, polish and review Chinese official documents, routine administrative materials and news articles. It covers many document types, from requests and reports to notices, resolutions, letters and speeches. It also handles Word layout for official documents.
summary.zh: 本技能用于起草、改写、压缩、润色和审核中文公文、事务性材料及新闻稿件。它覆盖申请、请示、报告、通知、决定、函、批复、纪要、讲话、新闻消息等多种文种。它也能处理公文的 Word 版式。

tagline.en: Place US phone calls for an AI agent
tagline.zh: 让AI代理拨打美国电话

summary.en: clawcall-dev lets an AI agent place real US phone calls for a user. It covers tasks such as calling a business, handling hold or phone menus, and confirming, rescheduling, cancelling, booking, or checking an order. It also manages calling preferences and answers inbound calls on a reserved number.
summary.zh: clawcall-dev 让AI代理代表用户拨打真实的美国电话。它可以用于致电商家、处理等待和语音菜单，也可以确认、改期、取消、预订或查询订单。它还能管理通话偏好，并在保留号码上接听来电。

tagline.en: Build, deploy and debug CloudBase (Tencent Cloud) apps
tagline.zh: 为腾讯云开发项目提供开发、部署与排错指引

summary.en: CloudBase is a set of backend services for WeChat Mini Programs and Web/H5 apps, including databases, cloud functions, cloud storage, auth and hosting. This skill guides an AI agent through building, deploying, debugging and migrating CloudBase projects. It sends each task to the matching reference so the agent works from the right rules.
summary.zh: 云开发为微信小程序和 Web/H5 应用提供后端服务，包括数据库、云函数、云存储、身份认证和静态托管。这个技能指导 AI 助手完成云开发项目的开发、部署、排错和迁移。它会把每个任务指向对应的参考文档，让助手按正确的规则工作。

tagline.en: Cournot event probabilities and pricing-divergence rankings
tagline.zh: Cournot事件概率与定价偏离排名

summary.en: This skill queries Cournot for a probability assessment of a specific event claim, and for a ranking of markets whose prices diverge. It also handles prepaid calls, balances and API keys. It runs only when you type /cournot or explicitly ask to use Cournot.
summary.zh: 这个技能会向Cournot查询某个具体事件判断的概率评估，也会查询定价偏离的市场排名。它还管理预付费调用次数、余额和API密钥。只有在你输入/cournot或明确要求使用Cournot时才会运行。

tagline.en: AI drafts for stories, scripts, and world building
tagline.zh: AI辅助创作小说、剧本与世界观

summary.en: Writes and plans fiction with CellCog. It covers short stories, novels, screenplays, fan fiction, and poetry, plus world building and character work. Each task goes to CellCog in creative mode, and the result comes back as a draft.
summary.zh: 通过 CellCog 撰写和规划小说类作品。内容包括短篇小说、长篇小说、剧本、同人小说和诗歌，也支持世界观与角色设计。每个任务都以创意模式发送给 CellCog，并返回一份草稿。

tagline.en: Build and edit XLSX workbooks without breaking formulas
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑 XLSX 工作簿，保证公式不被破坏

summary.en: This skill helps an agent create, inspect, and edit Excel workbooks and XLSX files. It covers formulas, dates, data types, formatting, recalculation, and keeping existing templates intact. It is aimed at spreadsheets where formulas, dates, or layout must still work after edits.
summary.zh: 这个技能帮助智能体创建、检查和编辑 Excel 工作簿与 XLSX 文件。它涵盖公式、日期、数据类型、格式、重新计算，以及保留现有模板。适用于编辑后公式、日期或版式仍需正确的表格。

tagline.en: Fathom meetings, transcripts and webhooks via Maton
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 访问 Fathom 会议内容与 Webhook

summary.en: This skill gives an agent access to the Fathom API through the maton CLI, using managed OAuth. It covers meeting recordings, transcripts, summaries, action items and webhook management. Calls run as the user's own Fathom connection, so they reach only what that connection is allowed to reach.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 maton 命令行工具，使用托管的 OAuth 授权，让智能体访问 Fathom API。可读取会议录音、转录文本、摘要和待办事项，也可管理 Webhook。调用以用户自己的 Fathom 连接身份进行，只能访问该连接被授权的内容。

tagline.en: Find OpenClaw skills by task, provider or category
tagline.zh: 按任务、服务或类别查找OpenClaw技能

summary.en: This skill searches for OpenClaw skills. It runs keyword searches and category browsing on ClawHub, and it lists other places to look, such as the OpenClaw Directory, LobeHub, and GitHub. It also points to other skills for managing installed skills and creating new ones.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于查找OpenClaw技能。它可以在ClawHub上按关键词搜索，也可以按类别浏览，并列出其他可查找的地方，例如OpenClaw Directory、LobeHub和GitHub。对于已设置的技能管理和新技能创建，它会指向对应的其他技能。

tagline.en: Sets OpenClaw to free OpenRouter models with fallbacks
tagline.zh: 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 免费模型并配置备用

summary.en: FreeRide configures OpenClaw to use free AI models from OpenRouter. It ranks the free models, sets the best one as the primary model, and adds ranked fallbacks so that rate limits do not stop the user. It updates only the model keys in openclaw.json and keeps the rest of the config as it is.
summary.zh: FreeRide 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 上的免费 AI 模型。它会对免费模型排序，把最好的一个设为主模型，并添加有序的备用模型，使速率限制不会打断用户。它只更新 openclaw.json 中的模型相关字段，其余配置保持不变。

tagline.en: Manage your GetNote notes via the official getnote CLI
tagline.zh: 通过官方 getnote CLI 管理得到笔记

summary.en: This skill lets your AI assistant save, find, read and organize notes in your GetNote account. It runs the official getnote CLI for each action and checks the real result before it reports success. It also handles browser login, connection checks and CLI upgrades.
summary.zh: 本 Skill 让 AI 助手在你的得到大脑账号中保存、查找、阅读和整理笔记。每个操作都通过官方 getnote CLI 执行，并在报告成功前检查真实结果。它还负责浏览器授权、连接诊断和 CLI 升级。

tagline.en: Work with GitHub issues, PRs, CI runs and API via gh
tagline.zh: 用 gh 处理 GitHub 议题、PR、CI 运行和 API

summary.en: This skill tells an agent how to use the `gh` CLI to work with GitHub. It covers issues, pull requests, workflow runs, and the `gh api` command for data the other subcommands do not reach. It shows commands for checking CI, reading failed step logs, and filtering output with `--json` and `--jq`.
summary.zh: 这个技能教代理如何使用 `gh` 命令行工具操作 GitHub。内容包括议题、拉取请求、工作流运行，以及用于获取其他子命令无法提供的数据的 `gh api`。文档给出了查看 CI 状态、读取失败步骤日志，以及用 `--json` 和 `--jq` 筛选输出的命令。

tagline.en: Read and manage Gmail through Maton's managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton 托管 OAuth 读写 Gmail

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read, send, and manage Gmail messages, threads, labels, and drafts. Calls run through the maton CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key where the CLI cannot be installed. Maton handles the OAuth sign-in, so you do not build the Gmail auth flow yourself.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体读取、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件、会话、标签和草稿。调用通过 maton 命令行工具进行；如果无法安装该工具，也可以用 Maton API 密钥直接发起 HTTP 请求。OAuth 登录由 Maton 处理，你不必自己实现 Gmail 的授权流程。

tagline.en: Command-line access to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets and Docs
tagline.zh: 在命令行中访问 Gmail、日历、云端硬盘、表格和文档

summary.en: gog is a command-line tool for Google Workspace. It lets you search and send Gmail, read and list Calendar events, search Drive, list Contacts, and read, write and clear Google Sheets ranges. It also exports and reads Google Docs. It needs a one-time OAuth setup before use.
summary.zh: gog 是一个用于 Google Workspace 的命令行工具。它可以搜索和发送 Gmail，读取日历事件，搜索云端硬盘，列出通讯录，以及读取、写入和清空 Google 表格区域。它还能导出和读取 Google 文档。使用前需要完成一次 OAuth 设置。

tagline.en: Google Analytics reads and admin changes via managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 托管 OAuth 下的 Google Analytics 报表与管理

summary.en: This skill gives access to Google Analytics through Maton's managed OAuth. It has two APIs: the Admin API, which can create, update, and delete accounts, properties, and data streams, and the Data API, which is read-only and runs reports on sessions, users, page views, and conversions. Calls run through the maton CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key where the CLI cannot be used.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 Maton 托管的 OAuth 访问 Google Analytics。它包含两个 API：Admin API 可以创建、更新和删除账号、资源和数据流，属于可写接口；Data API 只读，用于运行会话、用户、页面浏览和转化等报表。调用通过 maton 命令行工具进行，无法使用命令行时，可以用 Maton API 密钥发送原始 HTTP 请求。

tagline.en: Google Workspace directory access with approval for writes
tagline.zh: Google Workspace 管理访问，写操作需确认

summary.en: This skill lets an agent read and manage Google Workspace users, groups, organizational units, roles, and domain settings through the Admin SDK. It uses managed OAuth through the maton CLI, or raw HTTP with a Maton API key. Reads are the default, and every write needs the user's approval first.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Admin SDK 读取和管理 Google Workspace 的用户、群组、组织单位、角色和域设置。它使用 maton CLI 的托管 OAuth 连接，也可以在无法安装 CLI 时用 Maton API 密钥直接发送 HTTP 请求。默认只做读取和列出，每次写操作都需要用户先确认。

tagline.en: Edits text to remove common AI writing patterns
tagline.zh: 去除文本中常见的AI写作痕迹

summary.en: Humanizer is a writing editor for text that sounds like it was generated by AI. It finds patterns such as inflated wording, vague attributions, stock phrases, em dash overuse, and overused groups of three. It rewrites those sections so the text reads more direct and specific, while keeping the original meaning and tone.
summary.zh: Humanizer 是一个文本编辑技能，用于处理看起来像 AI 生成的文字。它会找出夸大措辞、模糊的出处、套话、过多的破折号以及滥用的三项并列等写法。改写后，文字会更直接、更具体，同时保留原意和语气。

tagline.en: AI image generation and editing through CellCog
tagline.zh: 通过 CellCog 生成和编辑 AI 图像

summary.en: This skill generates and edits images with AI through CellCog. You describe the image in a text prompt, or pass an existing image to edit or use as a reference. It covers single images, consistent characters across a set, product shots, and campaign image sets.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 CellCog 用 AI 生成和编辑图像。你可以用文字描述想要的画面，也可以传入已有图片进行编辑或作为参考。它适用于单张图片、跨多张图保持角色一致、产品图以及营销图片组。

tagline.en: Mainland China insurance advice: needs, comparisons, plans
tagline.zh: 中国大陆保险咨询、产品对比与方案设计

summary.en: This skill gives advice on personal and family insurance in mainland China. It analyzes coverage needs, compares products from a local product file, estimates premiums, and drafts plan options with a short list of recommended products. It also answers insurance questions, gives compliance notes, and outlines the claims process.
summary.zh: 本 skill 面向中国大陆的个人与家庭，提供保险咨询。它会分析保障需求，基于本地产品文件做产品对比，估算保费，并给出方案与推荐产品。它还能解答保险知识问题、提示合规要点，并说明理赔流程。

tagline.en: LinkedIn API access with managed OAuth via the maton CLI
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 访问 LinkedIn API

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the LinkedIn API through Maton's managed OAuth. It covers sharing posts, reading and managing profile and organization information, uploading media, and the Ad Library. Maton handles the OAuth login, so the developer does not have to build the authorization flow.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton 托管的 OAuth 调用 LinkedIn API。可用于发布帖子、读取和管理个人资料与组织信息、上传媒体，以及访问广告库。OAuth 登录由 Maton 处理，开发者无需自行实现授权流程。

tagline.en: Set up persistent memory search for Moltbot/Clawdbot
tagline.zh: 为 Moltbot/Clawdbot 配置持久记忆搜索

summary.en: This skill sets up memory search for Moltbot and Clawdbot agents. It covers the config block, a workspace layout with MEMORY.md and daily logs, and agent instructions for recalling stored context. It helps an agent answer questions about past work instead of starting from nothing each session.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于为 Moltbot 和 Clawdbot 的智能体配置记忆搜索。它包括配置项、带有 MEMORY.md 和每日日志的工作区结构，以及让智能体调用已存储上下文的指令。配置后，智能体回答关于过往工作的问题时，不必每次从零开始。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with Nano Banana Pro
tagline.zh: 用 Nano Banana Pro 生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs a script that creates new images from a text prompt or edits an existing image with a prompt. It uses Google's Nano Banana Pro API (Gemini 3 Pro Image) and supports 1K, 2K and 4K output. It saves the result as a PNG in the directory where you run it.
summary.zh: 这个技能运行一个脚本，可根据文字提示生成新图片，也可根据提示编辑已有图片。它调用 Google 的 Nano Banana Pro API（Gemini 3 Pro Image），支持 1K、2K 和 4K 输出。结果以 PNG 格式保存在运行命令时所在的目录中。

tagline.en: Persistent associative memory for AI agent sessions
tagline.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供跨会话的关联式持久记忆

summary.en: NeuralMemory is a local memory store for AI agents. It keeps facts, decisions, errors and preferences in a graph and recalls them by spreading activation rather than keyword or vector search. It helps an agent pick up past context across sessions.
summary.zh: NeuralMemory 是一个供 AI 智能体使用的本地记忆系统。它把事实、决策、错误和偏好保存在图结构中，通过扩散激活而不是关键词或向量搜索来召回。智能体因此能在不同会话之间接续过去的上下文。

tagline.en: Query Notion databases and pages with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 用托管 OAuth 查询 Notion 数据库和页面

summary.en: This skill lets an agent query Notion databases, search pages, and read workspace content through the `maton` CLI. Calls run under the user's own Notion connection, so they reach only what that connection is authorized to see. Write operations need explicit user confirmation of the target resource and connection.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 `maton` 命令行工具查询 Notion 数据库、搜索页面并读取工作区内容。调用使用用户自己的 Notion 连接，因此只能访问该连接已获授权的内容。任何写入操作都需要用户明确确认目标资源和所用连接。

tagline.en: Read, search and edit Obsidian vaults from the command line
tagline.zh: 从命令行读取、搜索和编辑 Obsidian 库

summary.en: This skill lets an agent or script work with Obsidian vaults. A vault is a normal folder of Markdown notes, and the skill uses the obsidian-cli tool to search, create, move and delete notes. Moving a note also updates the links that point to it.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体或脚本能够操作 Obsidian 笔记库。笔记库就是一个普通的 Markdown 笔记文件夹。技能通过 obsidian-cli 搜索、创建、移动和删除笔记。移动笔记时，指向它的链接也会一并更新。

tagline.en: Typed knowledge graph for agent memory and shared state
tagline.zh: 面向智能体记忆与共享状态的类型化知识图谱

summary.en: Ontology stores an agent's knowledge as typed entities, such as Person, Project, Task and Event, linked by typed relations. Each write is checked against type constraints before it is saved. Other skills can read and write the same objects, so they share state.
summary.zh: Ontology 把智能体的知识保存为带类型的实体，例如 Person、Project、Task 和 Event，实体之间通过带类型的关系相连。每次写入在保存前都会按类型约束检查。其他技能可以读写同一批对象，从而共享状态。

tagline.en: Local speech-to-text from the command line with Whisper
tagline.zh: 在命令行中用 Whisper 本地转写语音

summary.en: This skill runs OpenAI Whisper through the `whisper` CLI to transcribe audio on your own machine. It does not need an API key. It can write plain text or SRT output, and it can run the translate task on speech.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 `whisper` 命令行工具运行 OpenAI Whisper，在本机转写音频。无需 API 密钥。可输出纯文本或 SRT 字幕，也可对语音执行翻译任务。

tagline.en: Twitter/X and meme token data from the 6551 API
tagline.zh: 6551 API 的推特与 Meme 代币数据查询

summary.en: This skill queries Twitter/X data and meme token evidence through the 6551 platform REST API. It covers user profiles, tweet search, user tweets, follower events, deleted tweets, KOL followers, and meme token activity. It also includes a WebSocket feed for real-time events from accounts on your watch list.
summary.zh: 该技能通过 6551 平台 REST API 查询推特/X 数据和 Meme 代币证据。覆盖用户资料、推文搜索、用户推文、关注者变动、已删除推文、KOL 关注者和 Meme 代币活动。它还提供 WebSocket 通道，实时推送监控账号的事件。

tagline.en: Disk-based planning files for multi-step AI agent work
tagline.zh: 面向多步骤智能体任务的磁盘规划文件

summary.en: planning-with-files keeps a task's plan, findings, and progress in markdown files on disk, so an AI agent can work across many tool calls without relying on its context window. Lifecycle hooks inject the selected plan's context while the agent works. The skill has no network upload path, and it reads session history only when the user explicitly asks.
summary.zh: planning-with-files 把任务的计划、发现和进度记录在磁盘上的 Markdown 文件里，让 AI 智能体在多次工具调用中不必依赖上下文窗口保存状态。生命周期钩子会在工作过程中注入所选计划的上下文。该技能没有网络上传路径，只有在用户明确要求时才会读取会话历史。

tagline.en: Phone calls and incoming call answering for AI agents
tagline.zh: 为AI代理提供电话外呼与来电接听

summary.en: PollyReach gives an AI agent its own phone number. The agent can make calls for a human to book, inquire, complain, or confirm, and it can answer incoming calls and send summaries back. It is for tasks that need a phone call, not text or email.
summary.zh: PollyReach为AI代理分配一个专属电话号码。代理可以替用户打电话办事，例如预订、咨询、投诉或确认，也可以接听来电并把摘要发给用户。它适用于必须通过电话完成的任务，而不是文字或邮件能解决的事。

tagline.en: Build and edit PPTX decks with templates and visual QA
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑PPTX，支持模板与视觉检查

summary.en: This skill helps an agent create, inspect, and edit Microsoft PowerPoint .pptx decks. It covers layouts, placeholders, speaker notes, comments, charts, and template fidelity. It also sets a QA pass so the deck renders cleanly after edits.
summary.zh: 该技能帮助代理创建、检查和编辑 Microsoft PowerPoint 的 .pptx 演示文稿。内容涵盖版式、占位符、演讲者备注、批注、图表和模板一致性。编辑后，它还会做质量检查，确保演示文稿渲染正常。

tagline.en: Patterns for proactive work and context-loss recovery
tagline.zh: 主动工作与上下文丢失后的恢复模式

summary.en: Proactive Agent is a set of patterns and file templates for AI agents. It covers writing key details to disk, recovering after context is truncated, designing cron jobs, and limits on how the agent changes its own rules. It aims to make an agent act on likely needs and keep its state across sessions.
summary.zh: Proactive Agent 是一套面向 AI 智能体的模式和文件模板。它涵盖把关键细节写入磁盘、上下文被截断后的恢复、定时任务的设计，以及对智能体自我修改规则的限制。它的目标是让智能体在用户开口前处理可能需要的事，并在多次会话之间保持状态。

tagline.en: Salesforce CRM access through managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 管理 Salesforce CRM 数据

summary.en: The salesforce skill lets an agent query and change Salesforce CRM data through the maton CLI, over a managed OAuth connection to the user's Salesforce account. It is for Salesforce administration, and it can change CRM records, so each write needs the user's approval. It also explains how to turn an approved Salesforce read into a hosted function that a trigger can run on a schedule.
summary.zh: salesforce 技能让智能体通过 maton CLI 查询和修改 Salesforce CRM 数据，经由托管的 OAuth 连接访问用户自己的 Salesforce 账户。它面向 Salesforce 管理工作，且可能改动 CRM 记录，因此每次写入都需要用户批准。文档还说明了如何把已批准的 Salesforce 读取做成托管函数，并由触发器定时运行。

tagline.en: Web scraping with HTTP, stealth browsers and spiders
tagline.zh: 网页抓取：HTTP、隐身浏览器与爬虫

summary.en: Scrapling is a Python framework and CLI for scraping and crawling websites. It supports plain HTTP requests, stealth browsers with JavaScript rendering, and concurrent spiders. Its parser can relocate elements when a page changes.
summary.zh: Scrapling 是一个 Python 框架和命令行工具，用于抓取网页和爬取整站。它支持普通 HTTP 请求、带 JavaScript 渲染的隐身浏览器，以及并发爬虫。页面结构变化时，它的解析器可以重新定位元素。

tagline.en: Logs corrections and reflections into local memory tiers
tagline.zh: 记录纠正与反思，分层保存本地记忆

summary.en: This skill lets an agent review its own work and record what it learns. Corrections, explicit preferences and self-reflection notes are stored in local files under ~/self-improving/. Stored patterns move between hot, warm and cold tiers based on how often they are used.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体回顾自己的工作，并记录它学到的内容。用户纠正、明确的偏好和自我反思的记录都保存在 ~/self-improving/ 下的本地文件中。已保存的规律会根据使用频率在热、温、冷三层之间移动。

tagline.en: Logs errors, corrections and learnings for OpenClaw agents
tagline.zh: 为 OpenClaw 智能体记录错误、纠正与经验

summary.en: This skill gives an OpenClaw agent a set of markdown logs for failures, user corrections, missing features and better approaches. It helps the agent reuse these notes later, check whether they still hold, and promote the useful ones into workspace guidance files.
summary.zh: 这个技能为 OpenClaw 智能体提供一组 markdown 日志，用来记录命令失败、用户纠正、缺失的功能以及更好的做法。智能体之后可以复用这些记录，检查其是否仍然成立，并把有用的内容提升为工作区的指导文件。

tagline.en: Guide for creating and updating Claude skills
tagline.zh: 用于创建和更新 Claude 技能的指南

summary.en: skill-creator guides you through building a new Claude skill or updating an existing one. It covers the skill folder layout, the SKILL.md format, and the steps from planning to packaging. It helps keep each skill short and focused on knowledge Claude does not already have.
summary.zh: skill-creator 指导你创建新的 Claude 技能，或更新已有的技能。它说明技能的文件夹结构、SKILL.md 的格式，以及从规划到打包的步骤。它帮助每个技能保持简短，只包含 Claude 原本不知道的内容。

tagline.en: Security checks before installing an AI agent skill
tagline.zh: 安装智能体技能前的安全审查

summary.en: skill-vetter is a vetting protocol for AI agent skills. It gives the agent a fixed set of checks to run before installing a skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or another source. The result is a written report with red flags, required permissions, a risk level, and a verdict.
summary.zh: skill-vetter 是一套用于审查 AI 智能体技能的流程。它让智能体在从 ClawdHub、GitHub 或其他来源安装技能前，按固定清单逐项检查。检查结束后会生成一份书面报告，包含风险信号、所需权限、风险等级和结论。

tagline.en: Manage Stripe customers, billing and payments via Maton CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 Maton CLI 管理 Stripe 账户

summary.en: This skill lets an agent call the Stripe API through the Maton CLI. It covers customers, subscriptions, invoices, products, prices, and payments. The Stripe credential stays in the Maton gateway, and the agent only uses your own Maton login.
summary.zh: 该技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 调用 Stripe API，涵盖客户、订阅、发票、产品、价格和支付。Stripe 凭据保留在 Maton 网关中，智能体只使用你自己的 Maton 登录身份。

tagline.en: Tencent COS storage and CI media and document processing
tagline.zh: 腾讯云COS存储与数据万象处理

summary.en: This skill gives a developer one entry point for Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS) and Data Processing Service (CI, 数据万象). It covers file and bucket management, image, document, media, content review, voice and knowledge base tasks. It runs as Node.js scripts that return JSON.
summary.zh: 这个技能为开发者提供一个入口，用于管理腾讯云对象存储（COS）并调用数据万象（CI）能力。覆盖文件和存储桶管理、图片、文档、媒体、内容审核、语音和知识库等任务。它以 Node.js 脚本运行，输出 JSON。

tagline.en: Up to 4-minute AI videos from a single text prompt
tagline.zh: 单条文字提示生成最长4分钟的AI视频

summary.en: This skill generates marketing, explainer, educational, UGC, news-style and cinematic videos from one prompt. It handles the script, scenes, voiceover, lipsync, music and editing in one run. It is for people who need a finished video without producing each part by hand.
summary.zh: 这个技能可以根据一条提示生成营销、讲解、教育、UGC、新闻风格和电影感的视频。脚本、画面、配音、口型同步、配乐和剪辑都在一次运行中完成。适合需要直接拿到成片、而不想逐个环节手动制作的人。

tagline.en: Current weather and forecasts from wttr.in and Open-Meteo
tagline.zh: 查询当前天气与天气预报

summary.en: This skill gets current weather and forecasts by calling two free services with curl. It needs no API key. It covers quick text lookups from wttr.in and JSON data from Open-Meteo.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 curl 调用两个免费的天气服务，获取当前天气和天气预报。无需 API 密钥。文本查询使用 wttr.in，结构化的 JSON 数据使用 Open-Meteo。

tagline.en: Send WhatsApp Business messages with managed OAuth
tagline.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 管理 WhatsApp Business 消息

summary.en: This skill lets an agent use the WhatsApp Business API through the Maton CLI. It covers sending messages, managing message templates, handling media, and reading conversations. Authentication is handled by Maton's managed OAuth, so you do not manage WhatsApp tokens yourself.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 使用 WhatsApp Business API。它支持发送消息、管理消息模板、处理媒体文件，以及读取会话。认证由 Maton 托管的 OAuth 完成，你不需要自己管理 WhatsApp 的令牌。

tagline.en: Create and edit DOCX files with styles and review marks
tagline.zh: 创建和编辑 DOCX，保持样式与修订标记

summary.en: This skill helps you create, inspect, and edit Microsoft Word (.docx) files. It covers styles, numbering, tracked changes, comments, tables, sections, and compatibility checks. It is built for files where layout or review markup could break during editing.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于创建、检查和编辑 Microsoft Word（.docx）文件。它涵盖样式、编号、修订、批注、表格、节以及兼容性检查。它适用于排版或审阅标记在编辑中容易出错的文件。

tagline.en: Send and fetch encrypted files through an Xdrop server
tagline.zh: 通过 Xdrop 服务器加密收发文件

summary.en: This skill provides two bundled Bun scripts for an Xdrop server. One uploads local files or directories and prints a share link. The other downloads a share link, decrypts the files locally, and saves them.
summary.zh: 这个技能提供两个随附的 Bun 脚本，用于连接 Xdrop 服务器。上传脚本可以上传本地文件或目录，并输出分享链接。下载脚本可以获取分享链接，在本地解密文件并保存。

tagline.en: Source-first security review for codebases and services
tagline.zh: 基于源码的安全审计与漏洞复核

summary.en: Reviews source code for vulnerabilities that cross a real trust boundary. Each finding needs a named affected principal or resource, a source trace, a safe local reproduction where possible, and a smallest-effective fix. By default it gives guidance only; the full six-phase audit runs only when you ask for one.
summary.zh: 审查源代码中跨越真实信任边界的漏洞。每个发现都需要明确受影响的主体或资源、源码追踪路径，以及在可行时的安全本地复现，并给出最小有效的修复方案。默认只提供指导；只有在你明确要求时，才会运行完整的六阶段审计。

tagline.en: Choose Cloudflare products for a given need
tagline.zh: 按需求选择 Cloudflare 产品

summary.en: The cloudflare skill helps an agent turn a user's goal into a set of Cloudflare products. It maps common needs to products and points to the matching skills or docs. When a Cloudflare-proxied site shows an error page, it also helps decide whether to fix the Cloudflare configuration or the origin.
summary.zh: cloudflare 技能帮助智能体把用户的目标对应到具体的 Cloudflare 产品，并指向相应的技能或文档。遇到 Cloudflare 代理站点的错误页面时，它还能判断应修改 Cloudflare 配置，还是检查源站。

tagline.en: Writes or rewrites web page copy with supportable claims
tagline.zh: 撰写或改写网页文案，只写有依据的主张

summary.en: This skill writes or rewrites page copy for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, and feature pages. It first checks whether the input is a blank brief, a draft with a real voice, or a point edit, and changes only what that situation calls for. It also keeps claims supportable and removes common AI writing patterns.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于撰写或改写首页、落地页、定价页和功能页的文案。它会先判断输入是空白需求、带有真实语气的草稿，还是局部修改，只改动该情况需要的部分。它还会确保主张有据可依，并去掉常见的AI写作痕迹。

tagline.en: Design mobile app screens, then implement them
tagline.zh: 设计移动应用界面并实现为代码

summary.en: This skill lets an agent design mobile app screens with Sleek through its REST API, then edit the project and fetch the HTML and renders. It also guides the agent to implement the design in React Native or HTML. It covers the API rules that are easy to get wrong, such as auth, response parsing, and retries.
summary.zh: 这个技能让智能体通过 Sleek 的 REST API 设计移动应用界面，并编辑项目、获取 HTML 和渲染图。它还指导智能体把设计实现为 React Native 或 HTML。文中说明了容易出错的 API 规则，包括鉴权、响应解析和重试。

tagline.en: Smallest complete change, with a short reply
tagline.zh: 用最少的改动完整解决问题，回复简短

summary.en: Ponytail makes the agent solve each coding task with the smallest change that fully works. It keeps replies short enough for a busy reader and ends each one with what was skipped and what risk remains. It stays active for the whole session until you turn it off.
summary.zh: Ponytail 让智能体用能完整解决问题的最小改动来处理每个编码任务。回复保持简短，让忙碌的读者一眼就能看懂，并在结尾说明跳过了什么、还有什么风险。在你关闭之前，它在整个会话中一直生效。

tagline.en: Find the right skill for a UI or motion task
tagline.zh: 为界面和动效任务找到合适的技能

summary.en: Ask Emil is a router for the skills in this repo. You describe your situation, and it recommends one skill or a short sequence, with a reason and the next skill to reach for. It reads each skill's SKILL.md before recommending it, because the summaries are for orientation only.
summary.zh: Ask Emil 是本仓库技能的路由器。你描述当前情况，它会推荐一个技能或一小段流程，并说明理由和下一步该用的技能。推荐前，它会先读取对应技能的 SKILL.md，因为仓库里的简介只用于大致了解。

tagline.en: Timing and order for elements that move together
tagline.zh: 协调多个同时运动元素的节奏与顺序

summary.en: Choreograph decides how several animating elements relate: what moves, in what order, how much they overlap, and what stays still. It aims to make a group read as one motion instead of a set of separate animations with their own delays. Easing, duration and origin of a single animation are handled by the animate skill, not this one.
summary.zh: Choreograph 决定多个动画元素之间的关系：哪些元素动、按什么顺序动、彼此重叠多少，以及哪些保持不动。它的目标是让一组元素看起来像一个连贯的动作，而不是各自带着延迟的独立动画。单个动画的缓动、时长和起点由 animate 技能处理，不在这里。

tagline.en: Polish and animation decisions for UI components
tagline.zh: 界面组件的交互打磨与动效决策

summary.en: This skill guides UI component work on interaction details: press and hover states, popover origin, tooltip timing, transitions vs keyframes, clip-path effects, and drag behavior. It gives a decision order for whether to animate, why, which easing, and how long. It also sets a review format that lists each issue as a Before/After table row.
summary.zh: 这个技能指导界面组件中的交互细节，包括按下和悬停状态、弹出层的起点、提示框的时机、过渡与关键帧的选择、clip-path 效果以及拖拽行为。它给出一套决策顺序，说明是否需要动画、原因、缓动曲线和时长。评审时，它要求把每个问题写成一行 Before/After 表格。

tagline.en: Rules for drag, swipe and sheet gestures
tagline.zh: 拖拽、滑动和底部面板手势的实现规则

summary.en: Guidance for building gestures that users drag, swipe, fling, or hold. It splits each gesture into a tracking phase, where the element follows the pointer exactly, and a release phase, where a spring finishes the motion. It also covers when to use Vaul for sheets and how to keep gestures interruptible.
summary.zh: 为用户可拖拽、滑动、甩动或长按的交互提供构建指南。它把每个手势分为两个阶段：手指按下时，元素严格跟随指针；松开后，由弹簧动画完成后续运动。内容还包括何时用 Vaul 实现底部面板，以及如何让手势可以中途打断。

tagline.en: Turns design corrections into written rules for agents
tagline.zh: 把设计修正记成规则，供后续 agent 读取

summary.en: learn-taste reads a session's design corrections and turns each one into a rule with its reason. Rules go into DESIGN.md, a project skill, or a lint check, where the next agent reads them. It writes rules only and never changes component code.
summary.zh: learn-taste 读取会话中的设计修正，把每一条转成带原因的规则。规则会写入 DESIGN.md、项目 skill 或 lint 检查，供下一个 agent 读取。它只写规则，不修改组件代码。

tagline.en: Picks a frontend library from a curated list
tagline.zh: 从精选清单中为前端任务挑选库

summary.en: This skill recommends one library for a frontend task. It matches the task to a fixed list that covers UI primitives, toasts, drawers, charts, drag and drop, state, and styling. The user gets a single pick instead of a list of options.
summary.zh: 这个技能为前端任务推荐一个库。它把任务对应到固定清单上，清单涵盖基础 UI 组件、消息提示、抽屉、图表、拖放、状态管理和样式等类别。用户得到的是一个明确的推荐，而不是一堆选项。

tagline.en: Finds and removes animations an interface doesn't need
tagline.zh: 找出并删除界面中不必要的动画

summary.en: remove-animations audits the motion already in an interface and deletes or reduces the animations that don't earn their place. Each animation passes through a fixed decision tree, and code left unused by a removal is cleaned up. It only subtracts: it never adds motion or retunes easing or springs.
summary.zh: remove-animations 检查界面中已有的动效，删除或缩减那些不值得保留的动画。每个动画都会按固定的判断树过一遍，删除后失去用途的代码也会一并清理。它只做减法，不会新增动效，也不会调整缓动或弹簧参数。

tagline.en: Reviews animation code against a strict motion craft bar
tagline.zh: 按严格的动效标准审查动画代码

summary.en: review-animations is a review-only skill for animation and motion code. It checks a diff against ten standards and flags problems such as ease-in on UI, animating layout properties, and missing reduced-motion handling. It ends with a Block or Approve decision.
summary.zh: review-animations 是一个只做审查的技能，用于检查动画和动效代码。它会按十条标准检查代码差异，标记诸如对 UI 使用 ease-in、为布局属性做动画、缺少减少动效处理等问题。最后给出 Block 或 Approve 的结论。

tagline.en: Find real Reddit needs and draft disclosed, helpful replies
tagline.zh: 为 Reddit 帖子起草诚实披露的有用回复

summary.en: This skill finds Reddit threads where people ask for something your product does, then drafts short replies that help first. It names your product only when it truly answers the question, and it discloses your affiliation when it does. A human reviews and posts every reply.
summary.zh: 这个技能会找到 Reddit 上有人求助、而你的产品正好能解决的帖子，然后起草简短的回复，先帮助对方。只有当产品确实能回答问题时才提及它，并同时说明你与产品的关系。每条回复都由人工审阅后再发布。

tagline.en: Generate and edit AI music through the RunComfy CLI
tagline.zh: 用 RunComfy CLI 生成与编辑 AI 音乐

summary.en: AI Music is a skill that generates music on RunComfy through the runcomfy CLI. It chooses between ElevenLabs Music and ACE Step models based on what the user needs, such as a polished vocal track, a low-cost background track, or a multilingual song. It also covers editing an existing track by regenerating a time range or extending it.
summary.zh: AI Music 是一个通过 runcomfy 命令行在 RunComfy 上生成音乐的技能。它会根据用户的实际需求，在 ElevenLabs Music 和 ACE Step 模型之间选择，例如精致的人声歌曲、低成本的背景音乐或多语言歌曲。它还支持编辑已有音轨，包括重新生成某个时间段，或向前、向后延长音轨。

tagline.en: Reference for ADK agent code: patterns, APIs and recipes
tagline.zh: ADK 智能体代码参考：常用模式与示例

summary.en: A quick reference for writing agent code with Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK). It covers agent types, tools, orchestration, callbacks, state, and the graph Workflow API, with Python and Go references and a recipe catalog to study. It is for writing code only. Scaffolding and deployment are handled by other skills.
summary.zh: 这是一份用于编写智能体代码的快速参考，基于 Google 的 Agent Development Kit（ADK）。内容包括智能体类型、工具、编排模式、回调、状态管理，以及图形化的 Workflow API，并提供 Python 和 Go 的参考资料和可供学习的示例目录。它只负责编写代码。项目脚手架和部署由其他技能处理。

tagline.en: Modern web platform best practices lookup for UI and client JS
tagline.zh: 面向界面与前端 JS 的现代 Web 平台最佳实践检索

summary.en: Modern Web Guidance is a search and retrieve tool for current HTML, CSS, and client-side JavaScript practices. The agent looks up a guide for the capability it is about to build, then checks its code against that guide before it writes ad-hoc code or adds a dependency. This helps where web APIs have changed and older patterns would otherwise be used.
summary.zh: Modern Web Guidance 是一个用于检索现代 HTML、CSS 和前端 JavaScript 最佳实践的工具。智能体在动手实现某项能力前先查找对应指南，并在写代码后对照指南检查，而不是凭印象编写临时方案或随意添加依赖。它主要解决 Web 接口已经变化、旧写法仍被沿用的问题。

tagline.en: Work on HyperFrames video projects from the CLI
tagline.zh: 用命令行搭建、检查、编辑和渲染 HyperFrames 视频

summary.en: This skill gives an agent the HyperFrames command line for video projects. It covers scaffolding, checks, timeline edits, preview, render, share and project history. It also explains how to read `--json` output and recover from failed commands.
summary.zh: 这个技能为智能体提供 HyperFrames 的命令行工具，用于视频项目。它涵盖项目初始化、检查、时间线编辑、预览、渲染、分享和项目历史。它还说明如何读取 `--json` 输出，以及命令失败后如何恢复。

tagline.en: Get, make and grade media for HyperFrames videos
tagline.zh: 为 HyperFrames 视频获取、生成和调色媒体素材

summary.en: media-use finds or generates the media a HyperFrames video needs: music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar video, transcripts, cutouts and colour grades. It uses HeyGen or free local tools. It also treats footage that looks dark, flat or dull.
summary.zh: media-use 为 HyperFrames 视频查找或生成所需的媒体，包括音乐、音效、图片、图标、logo、配音、数字人视频、字幕转写、抠图和调色。它可以使用 HeyGen，也可以使用免费的本地工具。对于偏暗、发灰或平淡的素材，它也能处理。

tagline.en: Port Remotion and other animation code into HyperFrames
tagline.zh: 将Remotion等动画代码迁入HyperFrames

summary.en: This skill moves existing video code or footage into HyperFrames. It covers Remotion first, and also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, p5.js, canvas, plain HTML/CSS animation, and renders from Manim, After Effects or Blender. It then checks the result frame by frame against the original.
summary.zh: 这个技能把已有的视频代码或素材迁入 HyperFrames。优先支持 Remotion，也支持 Motion Canvas、Lottie、Three.js、p5.js、canvas、纯 HTML/CSS 动画，以及 Manim、After Effects、Blender 输出的渲染结果。迁移后，它会逐帧与原始视频对比，检查结果是否一致。

tagline.en: Rebuild a video as an editable HyperFrames project
tagline.zh: 把视频复刻为可编辑的 HyperFrames 项目

summary.en: Rebuilds an existing video as a HyperFrames project whose render is checked against the original frame by frame. It covers motion graphics, talking heads, live action and AI-generated footage. The result stays editable, so text, layers and timing can be changed after the rebuild.
summary.zh: 把已有视频重建为 HyperFrames 项目，并把渲染结果与原片逐帧对照。适用于动态图形、口播、实拍和 AI 生成的画面。结果仍可编辑，重建后可以修改文字、图层和时间。

tagline.en: Finished faceless explainer, story or children's song video
tagline.zh: 生成完整的无人出镜解说、故事或儿童歌曲视频

summary.en: This skill creates one finished faceless video with a consistent visual style and narration. It covers explainers, documentaries, illustrated stories, and children's music videos, and it can also edit a video it made earlier. It asks for missing settings before any paid generation starts.
summary.zh: 这个技能可以生成一个完整的无人出镜视频，画面风格统一，并配有旁白。它支持解说片、纪录片、图文故事和儿童音乐视频，也能编辑它之前生成的视频。在开始付费生成之前，它会先询问缺少的设置。

tagline.en: Generate images, video, 3D and audio on Higgsfield AI
tagline.zh: 用 Higgsfield 生成图片、视频、3D 与音频

summary.en: This skill submits generation jobs to Higgsfield AI models through the higgsfield CLI. It covers image, video, 3D, and audio generation, plus Marketing Studio ads and Virality Predictor video scoring. It picks a default model for each task so you can ask for an asset in plain language.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 higgsfield 命令行工具，向 Higgsfield AI 的模型提交生成任务。它覆盖图片、视频、3D 和音频生成，还包括 Marketing Studio 广告和 Virality Predictor 视频评分。每类任务都有默认模型，你可以用自然语言直接描述需求。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 调用50多种模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, LoRA styles, upscaling and text rendering, using models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve. You choose a model by its app ID and pass a JSON input.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 AI 图像模型。它支持文生图、图片编辑、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、放大和文字渲染，可用的模型包括 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream 和 Reve。你用应用 ID 选择模型，并传入 JSON 输入。

tagline.en: Terse answers that keep every technical fact
tagline.zh: 简短回答，保留全部技术事实

summary.en: This skill sets a terse reply style for the agent. Answers come first, filler is cut, and code, commands, paths, numbers and errors stay exact. It stays on for the whole session until the user says "stop caveman" or "normal mode".
summary.zh: 这个 skill 让智能体用简短的方式回复。先给答案，去掉废话，代码、命令、路径、数字和报错保持原样。在整个会话中一直有效，直到用户说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”。

tagline.en: Terse Conventional Commits messages, intent only
tagline.zh: 只写意图的 Conventional Commits 提交信息

summary.en: caveman-commit writes a commit message in Conventional Commits format. It keeps the subject short and imperative, and it adds a body only when the reason for the change is not clear from the diff. The output is a code block you can paste into git.
summary.zh: caveman-commit 按 Conventional Commits 格式编写提交信息。主题行简短,使用祈使语气。只有当改动的原因无法从 diff 看出时,才添加正文。输出为代码块,可直接粘贴到 git 中使用。

tagline.en: Compress memory files to cut input tokens
tagline.zh: 压缩记忆类文件，减少输入 token

summary.en: caveman-compress rewrites a natural language memory file, such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list, into short caveman-style text. It cuts the input tokens that the file costs each time it is loaded. The original is kept as a readable backup outside the project.
summary.zh: caveman-compress 把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单这类自然语言记忆文件改写成简短的 caveman 风格文本，减少每次加载时的输入 token。原文件会保存为一份可读的备份，放在项目目录之外。

tagline.en: Terse agent replies, with code and facts kept intact
tagline.zh: 精简回复，保留代码与技术事实

summary.en: ultracave makes the agent reply in short fragments. It drops filler, articles and repeated facts, and keeps code, commands, paths, error strings, numbers and negations exactly as written. It stays on for the whole session until you turn it off.
summary.zh: ultracave 让智能体用短句回复，去掉套话、冠词和重复的事实，同时把代码、命令、路径、报错信息、数字和否定词原样保留。开启后会一直生效，直到你关闭它。

tagline.en: Read, create and edit Feishu cloud documents
tagline.zh: 读取、创建和编辑飞书云文档与素材

summary.en: lark-doc works with Feishu cloud documents (Docx and Wiki). It reads, creates and edits documents, inserts and downloads images and attachments, and handles mind notes. It picks the right workflow from the document URL or token.
summary.zh: lark-doc 用于处理飞书云文档（Docx 和 Wiki）。它可以读取、创建和编辑文档，插入和下载图片与附件，并操作思维笔记。它根据文档的 URL 或 token 选择对应的操作流程。

tagline.en: Check a browser fingerprint for internal contradictions
tagline.zh: 检查浏览器指纹内部是否自相矛盾

summary.en: browser-fingerprint-audit runs the liarjs CLI against a browser and reports where its fingerprint contradicts the network view of the same request. It checks in-browser probes such as canvas, WebGL, audio, fonts, WebRTC and timezone against TLS, HTTP and ASN data seen at the edge. The result is a score from 0 to 100 and a list of failing checks.
summary.zh: browser-fingerprint-audit 调用 liarjs 命令行工具扫描浏览器，找出浏览器指纹与同一请求的网络视图之间的矛盾。它将画布、WebGL、音频、字体、WebRTC 和时区等浏览器内探测结果，与边缘节点看到的 TLS、HTTP 和 ASN 数据进行比对。结果是一个 0 到 100 的分数，以及未通过的检查项列表。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models
tagline.zh: 用 50+ 款 AI 模型生成与编辑图片

summary.en: This skill generates and edits images with 50+ AI models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve. It supports text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, upscaling and text rendering.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 50 多款 AI 图像模型来生成和编辑图片。可用模型包括 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream 和 Reve。支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘、LoRA、放大和文字渲染。

tagline.en: Reviews a diff against repo standards and the issue spec
tagline.zh: 按仓库编码规范与需求规格审查代码变更

summary.en: This skill reviews the changes between HEAD and a fixed point you give, such as a commit, branch, tag, or merge-base. It checks two things separately: whether the code follows the repo's documented coding standards, and whether it matches the originating issue or spec. Each check runs in its own sub-agent, and the results are shown side by side.
summary.zh: 这个技能会审查你指定的固定基准点（如提交、分支、标签或合并基点）到 HEAD 之间的改动。它分别检查两件事：代码是否符合仓库中记录的编码规范，以及代码是否与来源的 issue 或需求规格一致。两项检查各自在独立的子代理中运行，结果并排展示。

tagline.en: Structured loop for diagnosing hard bugs and slow code
tagline.zh: 诊断难缠 bug 与性能退化的结构化流程

summary.en: A six-phase process for diagnosing hard bugs and performance regressions. It starts by building a pass/fail loop that reproduces the user's exact symptom, then minimises the repro, forms ranked hypotheses, instruments the code, and adds a regression test with the fix. It is for bugs that the user reports as broken, throwing, failing, or slow.
summary.zh: 这是一个分六个阶段的流程，用于诊断难以定位的 bug 和性能退化。它先建立一个能复现用户具体症状的通过/失败回路，然后缩小复现步骤、按优先级提出假设、插入调试手段，最后在修复时加入回归测试。适用于用户报告系统坏了、报错、失败或变慢的情况。

tagline.en: Build and sharpen a project's domain model
tagline.zh: 构建并打磨项目的领域模型

summary.en: This skill helps you build and sharpen a project's domain model while you design. It flags terms that conflict with GLOSSARY.md, proposes precise names for vague ones, and records glossary entries and ADRs as decisions are made. It is for changing the model, not only reading it.
summary.zh: 这个技能在你做设计时，帮你构建并打磨项目的领域模型。它会指出与 GLOSSARY.md 冲突的术语，为模糊的说法提出精确的名称，并在决定形成时记录术语表条目和 ADR。它用于修改模型，而不只是查阅模型。

tagline.en: Block dangerous git commands in Claude Code before they run
tagline.zh: 在 Claude Code 中拦截危险的 git 命令

summary.en: This skill sets up a Claude Code PreToolUse hook. The hook checks Bash commands before Claude runs them and blocks git push, git reset --hard, git clean -f, git branch -D, and git checkout or restore on the whole tree. It stops Claude from running these commands without your review.
summary.zh: 这个技能会设置一个 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 钩子。钩子在 Claude 执行 Bash 命令前进行检查，阻止 git push、git reset --hard、git clean -f、git branch -D，以及对整个目录执行的 git checkout 或 git restore。这样，Claude 就不能在你没有审查的情况下运行这些命令。

tagline.en: Interview to sharpen a plan or design
tagline.zh: 通过追问打磨计划或设计

summary.en: grill-me is a skill that runs a relentless interview on a plan or design. Its SKILL.md is short. It hands the work to a separate skill named "grilling", so the details of the interview are defined there, not in this file.
summary.zh: grill-me 是一个对计划或设计进行连续追问的技能。它的 SKILL.md 很短，实际工作交给名为 "grilling" 的另一个技能完成，所以追问的具体方式不在这个文件里定义。

tagline.en: Interview a plan or design, and record ADRs and a glossary
tagline.zh: 追问方案或设计，同步记录 ADR 与术语表

summary.en: grill-with-docs runs a strict question-and-answer session on a plan or design. While it asks questions, it writes ADRs and a glossary. It does this by calling two other skills, grilling and domain-modeling.
summary.zh: grill-with-docs 会对方案或设计进行严格的一问一答。在提问的同时，它会写出 ADR 和术语表。它通过调用另外两个技能完成这些工作，分别是 grilling 和 domain-modeling。

tagline.en: Find shallow modules and plan how to deepen them
tagline.zh: 找出浅层模块，规划如何加深

summary.en: This skill scans a codebase for deepening opportunities, which are refactors that turn shallow modules into deep ones. It writes the candidates into a visual HTML report and opens it for you. You then pick one and work through its design in a guided discussion.
summary.zh: 这个 skill 扫描代码库，找出可以加深的地方，也就是把浅层模块重构为深层模块。结果会写入一份可视化的 HTML 报告，并自动打开。你选定一个候选项后，可以在引导式讨论中逐步完善它的设计。

tagline.en: Shared terms and a design checklist for software factories
tagline.zh: 软件工厂的共用术语与设计检查清单

summary.en: This skill gives a shared vocabulary for designing a software factory, a system of agents that turns tickets, PRs and schedules into merged code. It defines tasks, runs, runners and the services a factory plugs into, plus a checklist for finishing a design.
summary.zh: 这个技能为设计软件工厂提供统一术语。软件工厂是一组代理，把工单、PR 和定时任务变成已合并的代码。它定义了任务、运行、运行器以及工厂接入的各项服务，并给出完成设计的检查清单。

tagline.en: Triage issues and external PRs into agent-ready briefs
tagline.zh: 分拣议题和外部 PR，产出可交给智能体的说明

summary.en: The triage skill sorts issues and external pull requests through a fixed set of category and state roles. It checks whether the request already exists in the code, verifies the claim, and writes a brief for an agent or a human. The result is a clear next step for each item instead of an open thread.
summary.zh: 这个 triage 技能用一组固定的类别和状态角色，处理议题和外部拉取请求。它会检查代码中是否已经有对应实现，验证问题是否属实，并为智能体或开发者写出说明。每个条目都会有明确的下一步，而不是一直悬而未决。

tagline.en: Build, deploy and evaluate Foundry agents and models
tagline.zh: 用于构建、部署和评估 Foundry 智能体与模型

summary.en: This skill helps developers work with Microsoft Foundry resources. It covers model deployment, the full development lifecycle of AI agents, evaluation workflows, and troubleshooting. It routes each request to a matching sub-skill with its own steps.
summary.zh: 该技能帮助开发者使用 Microsoft Foundry 资源，涵盖模型部署、AI 智能体的完整开发流程、评估工作流和故障排查。它会把每个请求分派给对应的子技能，并按其步骤执行。

tagline.en: Drive and test web pages from the command line
tagline.zh: 用命令行操作和测试网页

summary.en: playwright-cli is a command line tool for controlling a Playwright browser. It opens pages, fills forms, clicks elements, and reads page state such as console output, network requests, cookies and storage. After each command it returns a snapshot of the page with element refs, so the next step can act on a ref directly.
summary.zh: playwright-cli 是一个命令行工具，用来控制 Playwright 浏览器。它可以打开页面、填写表单、点击元素，并读取控制台输出、网络请求、Cookie 和存储等页面状态。每条命令执行后，它都会返回带元素引用的页面快照，下一步可以直接用引用操作元素。

tagline.en: UI and UX design guidance, searched locally
tagline.zh: 界面与体验设计指南，本地检索

summary.en: UI/UX Pro Max is a design guidance skill for web, mobile, and desktop interfaces. It searches a local database of styles, color palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, icons, GSAP presets, chart types, and stacks. It gives a design system for new pages and domain-specific rules for building or reviewing UI.
summary.zh: UI/UX Pro Max 是一个面向网页、移动端和桌面端界面的设计指导技能。它检索本地数据库中的风格、配色、字体搭配、UX 规范、图标、GSAP 动效预设、图表类型和技术栈。新页面可以获得整体设计系统建议，构建或审查界面时可以按领域获得具体规则。

tagline.en: Stops generic coding-assistant UI on new pages
tagline.zh: 让新页面看起来是设计过的，而非批量生成的

summary.en: Hallmark is a design skill for new websites and pages built by a coding assistant. It applies a fixed set of rules against common default patterns, deals a theme so that separate builds do not look alike, and limits each screen to one idea. It runs when the user asks to build something new or names Hallmark.
summary.zh: Hallmark 是一个设计技能，用于编码助手为用户构建的新网站和新页面。它用一组固定规则限制常见的默认写法，为每次构建选定一个主题，使连续的构建不会趋同，并让每个屏幕只表达一个主题。当用户要求构建新内容或点名 Hallmark 时运行。

tagline.en: Find out what you want before building anything
tagline.zh: 开始构建前，先弄清你真正想要什么

summary.en: The brainstorming skill makes the agent ask questions and agree on a design before it builds anything new. It covers features, components, behavior changes, and planning outside software, such as a talk, a business, or a renovation. It ends with a written design doc that you approve, and then the work moves to a plan.
summary.zh: brainstorming 技能让代理在构建任何新东西之前，先通过提问弄清你想要什么，并与你就设计达成一致。它适用于功能、组件、行为修改，也适用于软件以外的规划，比如演讲、生意或装修。最后会写出一份设计文档，经你批准后，工作才转入计划阶段。

tagline.en: Turns a spec into a step-by-step implementation plan
tagline.zh: 把需求规格写成可执行的实施计划

summary.en: The writing-plans skill turns a spec or set of requirements for a multi-step task into an implementation plan, saved as a Markdown file. The plan names the exact files, signatures, spec values and tests for each task, so an engineer who has not seen the codebase can carry it out. It runs before any code is changed.
summary.zh: writing-plans 技能把多步骤任务的规格或需求写成实施计划，保存为 Markdown 文件。计划写明每个任务的具体文件、函数签名、规格中的值和对应测试，让没看过代码库的工程师也能按计划执行。这一步在修改代码之前完成。

tagline.en: Design, review and refine frontend interfaces
tagline.zh: 前端界面的设计、评审与打磨

summary.en: Impeccable helps an agent design, redesign, review and improve frontend UI. It covers websites, dashboards, forms, onboarding, and native iOS and Android screens. Each request is routed to a matching command and playbook, and the result is checked by looking at the rendered output.
summary.zh: Impeccable 帮助智能体设计、重做、评审和改进前端界面，覆盖网站、仪表盘、表单、引导流程，以及原生 iOS 和 Android 界面。每个请求会对应到相应的命令和操作手册，最后通过查看渲染结果来检查。

tagline.en: Reference for Prisma Client queries, filters, and transactions
tagline.zh: Prisma Client 查询、过滤与事务参考

summary.en: This skill is an API reference for Prisma Client. It covers model queries, filter operators, query options, relations, transactions, raw SQL, and client methods for current Prisma projects. It gives an agent the correct method names, options, and operators so it can write Prisma Client code without guessing.
summary.zh: 这个技能是 Prisma Client 的 API 参考。它涵盖模型查询、过滤操作符、查询选项、关系、事务、原生 SQL 和客户端方法，适用于当前的 Prisma 项目。它为智能体提供正确的方法名、选项和操作符，使其无需猜测即可编写 Prisma Client 代码。

tagline.en: Move a PostgreSQL app from Prisma ORM 6 or 7 to Prisma 8
tagline.zh: 将 PostgreSQL 应用从 Prisma ORM 6/7 升级到 Prisma 8

summary.en: This skill upgrades a Node.js server that uses PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM 6 or 7 to Prisma 8 in one pass. The schema.prisma file, the database and its data stay as they are. It also prepares an app for deployment on Prisma Compute, which runs only Prisma 8.
summary.zh: 这个技能可以一次性把使用 PostgreSQL 和 Prisma ORM 6 或 7 的 Node.js 服务升级到 Prisma 8。schema.prisma 文件、数据库和其中的数据都保持不变。它还能让应用做好部署准备，以便运行在只支持 Prisma 8 的 Prisma Compute 上。

tagline.en: Browser automation for AI agents using @e element refs
tagline.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供基于 @e 元素引用的浏览器自动化

summary.en: agent-browser lets an AI agent drive a web browser through the belt CLI and inference.sh. It opens pages, reads interactive elements as @e refs, and acts on them with clicks, form fills, drags, uploads and JavaScript. It can also take screenshots and record video of a session.
summary.zh: agent-browser 让 AI 智能体通过 belt 命令行工具和 inference.sh 操作网页浏览器。它打开页面，将可交互元素读取为 @e 引用，并对其执行点击、填写表单、拖放、上传文件和运行 JavaScript 等操作。它还能截图，并录制会话视频。

tagline.en: Run cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs, search and X
tagline.zh: 在云端运行图像、视频、大模型、搜索等 AI 应用

summary.en: This skill runs AI apps from inference.sh in the cloud through the belt CLI. It covers image and video generation, LLM calls, web search, 3D models and Twitter/X actions. No GPU is required on your machine.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 belt 命令行工具，在云端运行 inference.sh 上的 AI 应用。内容包括图像和视频生成、大模型调用、网页搜索、3D 模型，以及 Twitter/X 操作。本机不需要 GPU。

tagline.en: Talking head and avatar videos from a portrait and script
tagline.zh: 用肖像图和文字脚本生成数字人说话视频

summary.en: This skill creates AI avatar and talking head videos through the inference.sh belt CLI. The recommended model, P-Video-Avatar, has built-in text-to-speech, so a portrait image and a text script are enough to produce a video. Other models cover audio-driven avatars, lipsync on existing video, and dubbing.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 生成 AI 数字人和说话头像视频。推荐模型 P-Video-Avatar 内置语音合成，只需一张人像图和一段文字脚本即可生成视频。其他模型支持音频驱动的数字人、已有视频的口型同步和配音。

tagline.en: Routes Remotion tasks to the right sub-skill
tagline.zh: 为 Remotion 任务指向对应的子技能

summary.en: remotion-best-practices is a router for the other Remotion skills. It reads the request and points the agent to the reference that covers that task, such as creating a video, setting up a project, markup, captions, rendering, or upgrading. It also asks the agent to open Remotion Studio for preview and to leave user edits alone unless they are confirmed.
summary.zh: remotion-best-practices 是其他 Remotion 技能的路由入口。它根据用户的请求，引导智能体读取对应的参考文档，例如创建视频、搭建项目、编写标记、字幕、渲染或升级。它还要求智能体在项目可运行时打开 Remotion Studio 预览，并且在没有确认前不覆盖用户的改动。

tagline.en: Copy reusable Remotion video components into a project
tagline.zh: 把可复用的视频组件复制进 Remotion 项目

summary.en: Elements are reusable video components, such as titles, backgrounds, charts and caption styles. This skill copies an Element's source code into a Remotion project with `npx remotion elements use`, so the project owns an editable copy. It also adds Element libraries to Remotion Studio.
summary.zh: Element 是可复用的视频组件，例如标题、背景、图表和字幕样式。这个技能通过 `npx remotion elements use` 把 Element 的源代码复制进 Remotion 项目，项目中得到的是一份可以自由修改的副本。它还能把 Element 库添加到 Remotion Studio 中。

tagline.en: Add, find, fix and compose shadcn/ui components
tagline.zh: 在项目中添加、查找、修复和组合 shadcn/ui 组件

summary.en: A skill for working with shadcn/ui in a project. It adds components as source code through the shadcn CLI, searches registries, reads component docs, and applies rules for styling, forms, composition, icons and chat UI. It also covers presets and turning a DESIGN.md brand spec into a themed app.
summary.zh: 这是一个用于在项目中处理 shadcn/ui 的技能。它通过 shadcn CLI 以源码形式添加组件，搜索注册表，读取组件文档，并应用样式、表单、组件组合、图标和聊天界面相关的规则。它还涵盖预设，以及把 DESIGN.md 品牌规范转换为带主题的应用。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt CLI 调用 50 多个模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, editing, upscaling and text rendering across 50+ models. It is meant for art, product mockups, concept art, social graphics and marketing visuals.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具运行 AI 图片模型。它覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘、LoRA、图片编辑、放大和文字渲染，支持 50 多个模型。适用于艺术创作、产品效果图、概念图、社交媒体图片和营销视觉。

tagline.en: Audit a website and fix findings in code, then re-audit
tagline.zh: 审计网站并修复代码中的问题，再重新审计

summary.en: This skill runs a squirrelscan audit on a website using the squirrel CLI or the hosted MCP server. It returns a report covering SEO, performance, security, accessibility and other rule categories. It then maps each finding to the source file behind it, applies approved fixes in batches, and re-audits until the score reaches a target.
summary.zh: 该技能使用 squirrel CLI 或托管的 MCP 服务器对网站运行 squirrelscan 审计。报告涵盖 SEO、性能、安全、无障碍等规则类别。随后，它会将每项问题对应到背后的源文件，分批应用已确认的修复，并重新审计，直到分数达到目标。

tagline.en: Postgres rules for schema, queries, RLS and migrations
tagline.zh: Postgres 建表、查询、RLS 与迁移规则

summary.en: This skill is a set of Postgres best practice rules maintained by Supabase. It tells the agent to load the rules before it writes or changes anything in a Postgres database, including tables, migrations, RLS policies, indexes, and functions. The rules cover performance, security, and schema design, so they apply even to a one-column change or a single query.
summary.zh: 这个技能是 Supabase 维护的一组 Postgres 最佳实践规则。它要求智能体在编写或修改任何 Postgres 数据库中的内容之前先加载这些规则，包括表、迁移、RLS 策略、索引和函数。规则涵盖性能、安全和表结构设计，即使只是修改一列或一条查询，也适用。

tagline.en: Build and improve UI/UX in your existing project
tagline.zh: 在现有项目中构建和改进 UI/UX

summary.en: uizze-ui is an agent skill for building and improving UI and UX in a project you already have. It works from your code, assets and reference images, and can pull design systems, app examples, licensed fonts, icons and animation resources from uizze.com. It helps you change a screen without guessing at layout, states or licensing.
summary.zh: uizze-ui 是一个面向智能体的技能，用于在你已有的项目中构建和改进 UI 与 UX。它基于你的代码、素材和参考图工作，也可以从 uizze.com 获取设计系统、真实应用示例、有授权的字体、图标以及动效资源。它帮助你在不猜测布局、状态和授权的情况下修改界面。

tagline.en: Design UI screens on a canvas, then build them in your code
tagline.zh: 先在画布上设计界面，再写代码实现

summary.en: The ui-design skill designs screens on a UX Pilot canvas before any code is written. You can open and edit the designs there, then choose which screens to build. The skill then rebuilds the chosen screens in your project's own stack.
summary.zh: ui-design 技能会在写代码前，先用 UX Pilot 画布设计界面。你可以在画布上打开并修改设计稿，然后选定要实现的页面。技能会用你项目自己的技术栈重新实现这些页面。

tagline.en: Plans and drafts practical 1:1 user interview guides
tagline.zh: 规划并撰写实用的一对一用户访谈指南

summary.en: This skill creates, tailors, and reviews 1:1 user interview guides and scripts. It turns a learning goal into neutral core questions and optional probes for discovery, activation, churn, switching, or concept interviews. It also helps audit existing questions that are leading, hypothetical, generic, or overloaded.
summary.zh: 这个技能用于创建、调整和审查一对一用户访谈指南与访谈脚本。它把学习目标转化为中立的核心问题和可选追问，适用于客户发现、激活、流失、迁移或概念测试等访谈。它也能检查现有问题是否带有引导性、假设性、过于笼统或问题过多。

tagline.en: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
tagline.zh: 供 AI 代理使用的浏览器自动化 CLI

summary.en: agent-browser is a command line tool that lets an AI agent control Chrome or Chromium. It covers navigating pages, filling forms, clicking, taking screenshots, and extracting data. It also includes specialized guides for Electron apps, Slack, QA testing, and cloud browser providers.
summary.zh: agent-browser 是一个命令行工具，让 AI 代理可以控制 Chrome 或 Chromium。它支持打开页面、填写表单、点击、截图和提取数据。它还附带针对 Electron 应用、Slack、QA 测试和云端浏览器服务的专门指南。

tagline.en: Deploy and manage Vercel projects with access tokens
tagline.zh: 用访问令牌部署和管理 Vercel 项目

summary.en: This skill guides an AI agent through using the Vercel CLI with a token instead of `vercel login`. It covers finding the token, linking or targeting the project and team, deploying, and managing environment variables, domains, and logs. It keeps secrets out of command-line arguments and defaults deployments to preview.
summary.zh: 该技能指导 AI 代理使用令牌而不是 `vercel login` 来运行 Vercel CLI。它涵盖查找令牌、关联或指定项目与团队、部署，以及管理环境变量、域名和日志。它不会把密钥放进命令行参数，并默认部署为预览版本。

tagline.en: Checks UI code against Web Interface Guidelines
tagline.zh: 按 Web 界面指南检查 UI 代码

summary.en: Reviews UI code for compliance with the Web Interface Guidelines. It reads a rule file bundled with the skill, checks the files you name, and reports findings as terse file:line entries. Use it for a fast compliance pass on accessibility, design, or UX.
summary.zh: 按 Web 界面指南检查 UI 代码是否合规。它读取技能目录中打包的规则文件，检查你指定的文件，并以简洁的 file:line 格式列出问题。适合快速检查无障碍、设计或用户体验方面的问题。

tagline.en: Finds and adds agent skills for a task you describe
tagline.zh: 帮你找到并添加适合当前任务的代理技能

summary.en: This skill helps the agent find skills in the open agent skills ecosystem for a task the user describes. It searches with the Skills CLI, checks the source before recommending anything, and can add the skill for the user. It is for cases where the user asks how to do something or whether a skill exists for it.
summary.zh: 这个技能帮助代理在开放的代理技能生态中，为用户描述的任务找到合适的技能。它用 Skills CLI 搜索，推荐前先检查来源，并可以替用户添加该技能。适用于用户问如何完成某件事，或问是否有现成技能的情况。

tagline.en: Make talking head and avatar videos with the belt CLI
tagline.zh: 用 belt CLI 生成数字人与口播视频

summary.en: This skill creates AI avatar and talking head videos from a portrait image. You provide a script or an audio file, and it returns a video of the person speaking. It runs through the inference.sh belt CLI and includes several models.
summary.zh: 这个技能可以根据一张人像图片生成 AI 数字人和口播视频。你提供文案或音频文件，它会返回一段人物说话的视频。它通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行，内置多个模型。

tagline.en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt
tagline.zh: 用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图片

summary.en: This skill runs AI image models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA styles, editing, upscaling and text rendering. You pick a model by app ID and pass a prompt as JSON input.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具调用 AI 图片模型。支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、图片编辑、放大和文字渲染。你按应用 ID 选择模型，并用 JSON 格式传入提示词。

tagline.en: Generate AI videos from text or images via the belt CLI
tagline.zh: 通过 belt 命令行生成 AI 视频

summary.en: This skill runs AI video models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, upscaling and sound effects, with about 40 models to choose from. It helps when you need a short video and want to run a model from the command line instead of setting up each model separately.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具运行 AI 视频模型。它支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、视频编辑、口型同步、数字人动画、视频放大和音效生成，可选模型超过 40 个。当你需要一段短视频，并希望直接在命令行中运行模型，而不是逐个配置各家模型时，它会很有用。

tagline.en: Post, like, retweet and DM on X from the command line
tagline.zh: 通过命令行在 X 上发帖、点赞、转推和私信

summary.en: This skill runs Twitter/X actions through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers creating and deleting posts, with optional media, plus likes, retweets, direct messages, follows, and profile and post lookups. Each action is a belt app run call that takes a JSON input.
summary.zh: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具操作 Twitter/X。它支持创建和删除帖子（可附带媒体），也支持点赞、转推、发送私信、关注用户，以及查询用户资料和帖子。每个操作都是一条带 JSON 输入的 belt app run 命令。

tagline.en: Verifiable A-share, HK, US, fund, bond and macro data from Wind
tagline.zh: 万得权威可验证的A股、港股、美股、基金与宏观数据

summary.en: This skill queries Wind financial data through a local CLI that calls Wind's seven MCP services. It covers stock screening, quotes, financials, funds, ETFs, indexes, bonds, announcements, news and macro indicators. The agent reports only what Wind returns, plus any stated limits.
summary.zh: 本 Skill 通过本地 CLI 调用万得 Wind 的 7 个 MCP 服务查询金融数据，覆盖选股、行情、财务、基金、ETF、指数、债券、公告、新闻和宏观指标。智能体只报告万得返回的结果，并附上必要的限制说明。
